authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare & ICAR

nitrogen_kg_ha.name: Available Nitrogen (N)
nitrogen_kg_ha.low_guidance: Add well-decomposed Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 5 t/acre or seed inoculation with Azotobacter / Rhizobium culture.
nitrogen_kg_ha.high_guidance: Reduce Urea or synthetic nitrogen application by 25% to prevent vegetative lodging and pest susceptibility.

phosphorus_kg_ha.name: Available Phosphorus (P2O5)
phosphorus_kg_ha.low_guidance: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP) or rock phosphate blended with compost to improve root development.
phosphorus_kg_ha.high_guidance: Reduce DAP application to avoid zinc antagonism.

potassium_kg_ha.name: Available Potassium (K2O)
potassium_kg_ha.low_guidance: Incorporate Muriate of Potash (MOP) or wood ash in split doses to improve disease resistance and fruit firmness.

ph.name: Soil Reaction (pH)
ph.acidic_remediation: Apply agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) or dolomite @ 250 to 500 kg/ha based on buffering capacity.
ph.alkaline_remediation: Apply agricultural gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) @ 500 kg/ha and grow green manure crops like Dhaincha (Sesbania).

organic_carbon_pct.name: Organic Carbon (OC)
organic_carbon_pct.remediation: Incorporate vermicompost, cover crops, or biochar into the top 15cm soil layer.
